decisions.reason: This industrial AC voltage input module fits very closely with our existing measurement and automation knowledge base, so the feedback we receive is easy to absorb and use for incremental improvement rather than exit.

The four-channel solid state relay module is highly complementary to our control architecture and manufacturing capabilities, making it a strong adjacent product that our in-house R&D can readily support.

Although the server room monitoring sensor kit is more solution-specific than our core modules, it still reuses our sensor, controller and software platform sufficiently that continued learning and refinement remain more attractive than withdrawal.

The RGB LED control module builds on our established modular electronics and software interface competencies, but as a newer and somewhat less central extension it carries a modestly higher review risk until demand is clearer.

The remote access service for wallboxes aligns with our strategic expansion in charging and energy management and draws on our existing firmware, networking and platform knowledge, so we are likely to retain and develop it further.
